video.name: CRT
video.description:
Mimics old Cathode Ray Tube screens.

Works by squeezing the input texture into an "emulated" CRT resolution space, using 1 pixel to light up 1 R,G,B triad. Light emission is faked by a simple blur in that emulated low-res space.

Greetings to Matze <3

video.name: Shape Shifter 3D
video.description:
Shape Shifter: Real-Time 3D Creation and HDR Integration for Resolume

Take full control of your visuals with Shape Shifter, the ultimate 3D shader plugin for Resolume. This powerful tool lets you design, combine, and transform up to 10 fully customizable 3D shapes in real-time with seamless integration into Resolume's ecosystem, including real-time HDR reflection and lighting from any clip.

Key Features:

Up to 10 Customizable Shapes: Choose from spheres, boxes, toruses, cylinders, cones, hexagonal prisms, and more.
Advanced Boolean Operations: Union, subtract, and intersect shapes with smooth blending options for refined transitions.

Dynamic Transformations: Bend, twist, skew, mirror, and rotate each shape individually.

Precision Control: Deform shapes using rounding, onioning, and adjustable edge thickness for unique results.

Noise Deformation & Eye Textures: Add 3D and 2D noise effects or apply eye textures for personalized details.

Real-Time HDR Lighting Integration: React to any clip in Resolume and use HDR image-based lighting to create dynamic, responsive visuals that change with your content.

Flexible Materials & Lighting: Customize color, roughness, metallic properties, and control multiple light sources for stunning reflections and highlights.

Adaptive Camera Control: Orbit and zoom with flexible camera transformations for the perfect angle on your scene.

Efficient Rendering: Optimized for performance with advanced ray-marching techniques, adaptive step sizes, and anti-aliasing.

Unleash limitless possibilities and elevate your visual performance with Shape Shifter's next-gen 3D creation. Whether youâre generating complex geometric patterns or organic, fluid forms, Shape Shifter allows you to create visuals that seamlessly react to live content in Resolume.

Recommended System Requirements:

CPU: Intel Core i9 or AMD Ryzen 9 (12+ cores for faster computation of complex shader effects).
GPU: Nvidia RTX 3070 or higher (preferably an RTX 4070 or better for real-time performance with HDR lighting, reflections, and high-resolution outputs).
RAM: 32 GB or more (16 GB will work, but 32 GB is recommended for heavier workloads, especially when multitasking).
Storage: SSD (NVMe preferred) with at least 1 TB of free space for fast file read/write speeds, especially with media-heavy projects.
Display: 1080p
OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) or macOS (if using Apple Silicon-based devices).
Minimum System Requirements:

CPU: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 7.
GPU: Nvidia GTX 1660 or RTX 2060.
RAM: 16 GB.
Storage: SSD (SATA or NVMe).
OS: Windows 10 (64-bit).
